content: Updated all semver-compatible deps across main and 3 bridges. Also applied compatible major bumps: @atproto/repo 0.8->0.9, @atproto/sync 0.1->0.2, @vitejs/plugin-react 4->6, vite 7->8, esbuild 0.25->0.28, jsdom 27->29, lucide-react 0.544->1.7, tailwind-merge 2->3, globals 16->17, typescript 5.9->6.0 (main + 2 bridges), dotenv 16->17 in osprey bridges, plus replit plugins. Fixed pre-existing TS errors in bridges and migrated firehose-to-kafka to skyware/firehose 0.5.x API. 0 audit vulns. 1206/1206 tests passing. Lint clean. Build clean.
